36184: She is an energetic and mostly optimistic school girl. She was born in Tokyo, but is sent to live at her grandmother's inn, Kissuisō, when her mother elopes with her boyfriend to avoid debt. At her grandmother's request, she works at the inn as compensation for her residency.
37212: Minko is an apprentice chef and resident at Kissuisō. She has a very cold demeanor, often telling Ohana to 'die' following their first encounter, though when this is considered too harsh by Ohana, she settles for calling her a balut instead.
37215: Nako is a cleaning maid and waitress working part-time at Kissuisō. She has a shy and timid personality, with a tendency to avoid unwanted social interaction.
39194: Yuina is a 16-year-old teenager who is daughter of the Fukuya Inn owners that are rivals with Kissuisō. While a rivalry exists between Yuina's and Ohana's grandmothers, she remains friendly towards Ohana.
39195: Ohana's best friend, who is in love with her. He does things in a patient and round about manner.
39196: Senior serving attendant at Kissuisō who likes to gossip. Tends to be jealous of any younger girls/woman that have a boyfriend.
39197: Because of Ohana's mother's running away, he was designated to be the next head of Kissuiso.
39198: A 23-year-old junior chef working at Kissuisō, Tohru is harsh and hardworking in matters of work, spending his time learning with the main chef and at the same time, teaching Minko at the kitchen. He is very outspoken and has a tendency to scold Minko and tease Ohana.
39199: Ohana's mother, who works as a professional writer. Satsuki is seen on bad terms with her own mother, calling her "the mother I've always hated".
39200: Renji Togashi is 42 year old chef working at Kissuiso inn. He is Tohru's mentor and the Head chef. He gets nervous under pressure but is mostly calm and stern. He has an unusual taste in clothes.
39201: The building maintenance manager at Kissuisō. He is nicknamed "Beanman" by others since he used to work at a bean factory.
39202: Takako is a 30-year-old business consultant adviser for Kissuiso. She attended the same university as Enishi. Trying to revitalize the inn, she works hard in order to have the staff have the correct manners.
43082: Appears in episode 11. A girl who works with Ko-chan in the bookstore.
47439: Appears in episodes 19 to 21. She's a classmate of Nako and also a part of the Cultural Festival Committee. Has a timid personality. She is a good painter so Nako and the rest of her class decided to feature her artworks for the cultural festival.
144969: Classmate and friend of Yuki Kaito.
